item.title: Trump administration launches TrumpRx website for discounted drugs
item.description: The Trump administration on Thursday launched TrumpRx, a website it says will help patients buy prescription drugs directly at a discounted rate at a time when health care and the cost of living are growing concerns for Americans.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie's family renews plea to mother's kidnapper, while sheriff says they have no suspect
item.description: “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie's brother on Thursday renewed the family's plea for their mother's kidnapper to contact them, hours after an Arizona sheriff said investigators don't have proof Nancy Guthrie is alive but believe “she's still out there.”

item.description: A 51-year-old man has died after his body was found in New Bedford Harbor last weekend.

item.description: As New Englanders solidify their game day plans for this weekend, local law enforcement want to make sure they include a safe and sober ride home.

item.title: Alviti pens open letter to RI, says: 'I am leaving on my own terms'
item.description: In an open letter, outgoing RIDOT Director Peter Alviti said it was an honor to serve as RIDOT's director for the last 11 years, calling it "the pinnacle" of his career as an engineer.
